Rename across files for a client that cannot confirm edits: the certain
edits only, and the user is told of the possible one left.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define LIVING "/std/living"
-- lib/std/base.c --
string name;

string query_name() { return name; }
-- lib/std/living.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit "/std/base";

int hp;

string query_name() { return "living " + ::query_name(); }
-- lib/obj/monster.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit LIVING;

string query_name() { return "monster"; }

void f(object ob) {
    write(query_name());
    ob->query_name();
    LIVING->query_name();
    call_out("query_name", 1);
}
-- lib/obj/other.c --
string query_name() { return "other"; }
-- lib/obj/saver.c --
inherit "/std/living";
void save() { save_object("/data/x"); }
